description: Hurricane Harvey (Texas) Supplement -- Collaborative Research: Geotechnical Extreme Events Reconnaissance (GEER) Association: Turning Disaster into Knowledge is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Tracy Kijewski-Correa, University of Notre Dame (nd.edu). Hurricane Harvey made landfall August 25, 2017 near Rockport, TX. With maximum winds of 130 mph, Harvey was the first Category 4 hurricane to make landfall in the US in over a decade and the first storm of this intensity to hit Texas since 1961. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2Q38J. Keywords: Hurricane Harvey, Texas, Wind, Surge, Reconnaissance. Published 2018-05-23. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
